concept.hr: Težine i granica procesora, granice memorije; OOM unutar kontrolne grupe
concept.en: CPU weights and caps, memory limits; OOM inside a cgroup

summary.hr: Postavi granice trima grupama i pusti pohlepne procese: tko dobiva procesor, tko je prigušen i koga OOM killer ubija iako domaćin ima memorije.
summary.en: Set limits on three groups and run greedy workloads: who gets the CPU, who is throttled, and whom the OOM killer kills while the host has RAM free.

title.en: A weight is not a limit

concept.hr: Udio koji druga grupa ne troši dobiva grupa s manjom težinom
concept.en: A share another group leaves unused goes to the lighter group

title.en: memory.high slows down, it does not kill

concept.hr: Iznad memory.high grupa se usporava; ubija tek memory.max
concept.en: Above memory.high the group is slowed; only memory.max kills

concept.hr: OOM killer ubija proces grupe iako domaćin ima 15 GB slobodno
concept.en: The OOM killer kills a process of the group though the host has 15 GB free
